versions.changelog: R20 upgrade 0.3.0: align judgment, evidence and trust boundaries; regression fixes and release checks. Validation limits and remaining issues are documented in the bundled CHANGELOG.md.

Hardening-loop stop condition upgraded from single terminal state to a four-way disjunction: converged / cap (limits live in the condition) / no-progress / RESTART-ESCALATE (a defect whose regression points at the previous round's added check stops the loop and reports). R17 audit; no script changes.
2026-07-06 refresh: remove neat from distribution and republish remaining skills.
Initial ClawHub release — live MP runtime debug via vince-mp CLI.
